author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Fresh figs are one of the sweetest signs of the harvest season 🌿🏡 In this video, we gather ripe figs and turn them into delicious homemade treats, from fragrant jam and preserves to fresh village-style baking.

Slowly cooked figs become rich and naturally sweet, capturing the flavor of the season in every jar. We also use fresh figs for homemade baking, creating a warm and comforting treat to enjoy with the family.

Fig season is a wonderful time for traditional village cooking and preserving. Fresh fruit, simple ingredients, and homemade methods allow us to enjoy the harvest in different ways — freshly baked today and carefully preserved for the months ahead. 🫙🌿🍰
title: Fig Season in the Village | Jam, Preserves & Homemade Baking 🏡🌿
